title: Direct booking request
summary: Call the hotel directly to ask about current room availability and the best confirmed rate for your dates.
description: A practical direct-booking CTA rather than a guaranteed discount.
terms: Rates and availability change by date and must be confirmed by reception.
body: Direct contact is the clearest way to confirm current room availability, bed setup and arrival time.
Use this offer block as a booking prompt, not as a promise of a fixed discount.
highlights: Ask about room category and rate

title: Transit guest stay
summary: A suggested offer concept for guests arriving by bus or rail who need a straightforward overnight stay.
description: Convenient stay positioning for travelers using Ternopil transport links.
terms: Publish as an active promotion only after client confirmation.
body: The hotel location near the central bus station makes this a natural offer concept for transit guests.
The final commercial terms should be approved by the business before publication as a discount.
highlights: Useful for late arrival or early departure

title: Family room request
summary: Ask reception about family triple and improved family triple rooms for small family stays.
description: A family-stay CTA based on confirmed room categories.
terms: Room setup, view and price must be confirmed for current dates.
body: Family and improved family triple categories are listed publicly for Passage Hotel.
Call before booking to confirm exact bed setup and whether the room fits your family needs.
